text.arabic_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

words.gloss_range: consequential and resumptive connector launching the verdict from the prior resurrection scene
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the judgment statement a result rather than a detached saying. It both resumes a new verdict unit and ties that unit to the assembly of 36:53; fused to the time word that follows, it lets consequence and timing arrive in the first movement of the ayah.

topics.headline: consequential verdict launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict begins as the immediate consequence of the resurrection assembly in 36:53, while still opening a new juridical declaration.
topics.reason: The QAC gloss allows resumptive and consequential force, and the boundary rows consistently connect this opening particle to the previous assembly scene rather than to an unrelated topic.

words.gloss_range: the definite, fronted Day as the time-frame of judgment
words.root_gloss_range: bounded time, day, period, or evaluation frame; here narrowed to the recognized reckoning Day
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْيَوْمَ}} ({{tr:al-yawma}}) is not a loose time marker. Its definiteness, singularity, accusative adverbial role, and fronted position make the known Day the doorway into both judgment clauses: no wronging and no recompense beyond deeds happen under one frame. The broader {{ar:ي و م}} ({{tr:y-w-m}}) range includes periods and evaluative spans, but the local syntax selects the recognized reckoning scene, a formulaic judgment register also attested in the cited parallels (6:93, 45:28, 46:20, 66:7).

topics.headline: definite fronted judgment day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Day is made the single governing frame for both halves of the verdict, not merely the date of one verb.
topics.reason: The accusative temporal adverb is fronted before both negated clauses, and attachment evidence licenses it as the time frame for the passive predicate complex.

topics.headline: bounded time narrowed to reckoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the broad day-period root range is being used as a bounded evaluation frame, with formulaic judgment echoes held inside the local Day scene.
topics.reason: The root can cover wider time periods, but the definite singular adverb and surrounding courtroom language narrow the active sense to the recognized Day of reckoning.

words.gloss_range: categorical negation over the first passive wronging clause
words.prose: The first {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) places explicit negation before the passive wronging verb, so the clause denies the event as a rule within the judgment scene. It also starts the mirrored polarity architecture later answered by the second {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), making the ayah's first beat universal non-wronging before the address turns personal.

topics.headline: first categorical denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first clause is a principled denial of wronging, not merely a report that no harm happens once.
topics.reason: The particle directly scopes over the imperfect passive and the translation support marks the whole first clause as a preserved negation scope.

topics.headline: mirrored negation frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two-clause design: the first denial of injustice is structurally paired with the later denial of recompense beyond deeds.
topics.reason: The repeated negation particles stand before coordinated passive verbs, so the structural mirror is locally visible.

words.gloss_range: passive non-wronging; denial of injustice or displacement in the judgment frame
words.root_gloss_range: wronging, injustice, displacement from due place, and darkness; here legal non-wronging is primary while darkness/displacement imagery is secondary

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: cross-word grammatical anchor used in the local prose
cross-word grammatical anchor used in the local prose

words.prose: {{ar:تُظْلَمُ}} ({{tr:tuẓlamu}}) is passive, so the protected patient rather than a possible wrongdoer becomes central. The 3fs imperfect agrees forward with {{ar:نَفْسٌ}} ({{tr:nafsun}}), and under {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) it presents non-wronging as an operative rule. The {{ar:ظ ل م}} ({{tr:ẓ-l-m}}) field can carry injustice, displacement, and darkness; locally the legal sense governs, while the broader field lets the denial feel like protection from any hidden or misplaced verdict. As the first courtroom verb after the assembly of 36:53, it also places a recurring passive non-wronging formula (2:272, 2:281, 3:25) at the threshold of the verdict.

topics.headline: passive centers the protected patient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar centers the soul as the protected patient and suppresses any wronging agent.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a passive imperfect with the agent suppressed and {{ar:نَفْسٌ}} ({{tr:nafsun}}) as the passive subject.

topics.headline: injustice narrowed with darkness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that legal injustice is the selected sense, but the root's displacement and darkness fields sharpen the claim into no hidden or misplaced treatment of a soul.
topics.reason: The local passive judgment clause selects wronging or injustice, while the cited root-family evidence can color that sense without replacing it.

topics.headline: formulaic courtroom verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this passive non-wronging belongs to a recurring judgment formula, here placed as the first courtroom verb after the resurrection assembly.
topics.reason: Formula and boundary rows are coherent with the local passive form and do not override the local syntax.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite singular self or soul as the passive subject protected from wronging
words.root_gloss_range: self, soul, person, breath, life-force, and identity; here the accountable self is selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: cross-word grammatical anchor used in the local prose

words.prose: {{ar:نَفْسٌ}} ({{tr:nafsun}}) is the nominative passive subject of {{ar:تُظْلَمُ}} ({{tr:tuẓlamu}}). Its indefinite singular form makes the protection distributive: any individual self counts, not only a class or crowd. The {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}) range includes soul, self, breath, life, and whole identity; locally it selects the accountable self, while that range keeps the protected unit vivid rather than abstract. After the assembly of 36:53, this singular legal self mediates the movement from the gathered crowd into the direct plural address that follows.

topics.headline: indefinite protected self
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the statement protects each individual self, not merely humanity as an undifferentiated mass.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite, singular, nominative, and attached as the passive subject of the wronging verb.

topics.headline: selfhood with breath-life range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the protected legal subject is a whole living identity, while local grammar keeps the sense from expanding into every possible root branch.
topics.reason: The broader root range is real, but the passive-subject role selects the accountable self.

topics.headline: from assembly to individual accounting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from the assembled crowd in 36:53 into a singular legal self, before the next clause turns to direct plural address.
topics.reason: The formula and boundary rows align with the singular passive subject and the following second-person plural shift.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative scope term specifying any degree or unit of wronging
words.root_gloss_range: thing, matter, entity, knowable item, with possible will-derived pressure; here narrowed to maximal scope under negation
words.prose: {{ar:شَيْـًۭٔا}} ({{tr:shay'an}}) closes the first clause by specifying the extent of the denied wronging. Whether read as an accusative specification or an intensifying absolute-object type, its indefinite thing-word form makes the denial reach any measurable unit at all. The broad {{ar:ش ي ء}} ({{tr:sh-y-ʾ}}) range of thing, entity, and knowable item supports maximal auditability here; possible will-derived pressure can deepen the sense that every brought-into-being unit is included, while the local role keeps that background within the scope of non-wronging.

topics.headline: total-scope specification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first clause does not merely deny major injustice; it denies wronging in any measurable respect.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the noun as extent specification under the first negation, and the indefinite accusative form supports maximal scope.

topics.headline: thingness as auditability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the broad thing-word makes every knowable unit of the case count, while possible will-derived background stays secondary to the local scope function.
topics.reason: The root range can enrich the scope, but local syntax does not make will or being the selected meaning.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining two complete negated verdict clauses
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the two verdict clauses linked without collapsing them. It closes the universal non-wronging clause and opens a fresh negated recompense clause, so the ayah can move from any soul to direct plural address while remaining one coordinated legal declaration.

topics.headline: coordinated verdict clauses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second rule is coordinated with the first, not appended as a loose afterthought.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence explicitly marks the second passive verb as conjoined with the first.

topics.headline: universal to personal pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hinge from generic soul-protection to direct accountability, with the conjunction carrying the shift instead of breaking the ayah.
topics.reason: The following verb is second-person plural, while the preceding subject is an indefinite singular self, making the pivot locally visible.

words.gloss_range: second negation beginning the restrictive no-recompense-except structure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: cross-word grammatical anchor used in the local prose
cross-word grammatical anchor used in the local prose

words.prose: The second {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates {{ar:تُجْزَوْنَ}} ({{tr:tujzawna}}) and then stretches through the coming exception. With {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}), it becomes a restriction: recompense is denied on every basis except the deed clause. Because it mirrors the first {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), the ayah balances universal protection with direct accountability.

topics.headline: negator opening restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second negation is not simple denial; it opens the only-deeds restriction.
topics.reason: The negation precedes the passive recompense verb and is completed by the exception structure.

topics.headline: paired negation legal arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the two repeated negators form a legal arc from no wronging of any self to no recompense beyond deeds.
topics.reason: The repeated particle is locally coordinated across two passive clauses and the second clause changes address and restriction.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural passive recompense, restricted to what the addressees used to do
words.root_gloss_range: recompense, requital, reward, punishment, and proportional return; here value-neutral return by deed correspondence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: cross-word grammatical anchor used in the local prose

words.prose: {{ar:تُجْزَوْنَ}} ({{tr:tujzawna}}) turns the ayah from any soul to you plural. It is passive, so the addressees receive recompense while the recompenser is not named, and its object relation is completed only by the later {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) clause. The recompense field can be reward or punishment, but the {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) ... {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) restriction makes the local force proportional return according to deeds. The wording also enters a recurring judgment formula (7:147, 27:90), while the second-person endings across {{ar:تُجْزَوْنَ}} ({{tr:tujzawna}}), {{ar:كُنتُمْ}} ({{tr:kuntum}}), and {{ar:تَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:ta'malūna}}) keep the addressed audience audible.

topics.headline: passive direct recompense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the confrontation: the assembled audience is addressed directly as the passive recipient of recompense.
topics.reason: The verb is second-person masculine plural passive, with the addressees as the implied passive subject and the retained object supplied by the restriction.

topics.headline: proportional return by deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recompense is not pre-labeled as reward or punishment; its value is determined by correspondence to the addressees' own deeds.
topics.reason: The root range includes positive and negative return, but the exception clause narrows the local force to deed-correspondent recompense.

topics.headline: verdict formula with addressed cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase joins a recurring judgment formula (7:147, 27:90) while the second-person endings keep the addressed audience audible.
topics.reason: The formulaic and phonetic claims are consistent with the local second-person passive and the following deed-restriction.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing restriction and pivoting to the retained deed basis
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hinge where the second negation becomes exact restriction. Before it, recompense is denied; after it, the only retained basis is introduced. Its compact particle form and sharp onset reinforce that logical turn, but its main work is grammatical: all other bases are excluded and the deed clause alone remains.

topics.headline: exception restriction hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the precise turn from denied recompense to the single retained basis: what the addressees used to do.
topics.reason: The particle follows negated recompense and immediately precedes the retained relative pronoun.

topics.headline: audible exception break
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exception marker is also a felt break in the clause, matching the shift from exclusion to specification.
topics.reason: The phonetic and boundary observations reinforce the locally forced exception function without adding a separate lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun retained after exception and object of both recompense and doing clauses

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: cross-word grammatical anchor used in the local prose
cross-word grammatical anchor used in the local prose

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) supplies the content that survives the exception. It is the retained object after {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) and also the object completed by {{ar:تَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:ta'malūna}}) inside the relative clause, so recompense is routed back into the addressees' own deed-content. The surface can also be heard with maṣdariyya pressure, shifting attention from what was done to the doing itself; both readings remain inside the same restriction.

topics.headline: relative deed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exception does not stay abstract; it becomes a relative deed clause tied to the same addressees.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as the retained object of recompense and the object inside the relative clause.

topics.headline: what-done and doing-process
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the retained basis can lean toward deed-products or the doing-process, but either way it remains the only ground of recompense.
topics.reason: The QAC tag selects relative pronoun, while CRITICAL rows preserve a licensed functional ambiguity that does not change the restriction's scope.

words.gloss_range: perfect second-person plural auxiliary forming habitual past with the following imperfect
words.root_gloss_range: being, existing, becoming, occurring, and auxiliary past; here narrowed to established past state in a judgment formula

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: cross-word grammatical anchor used in the local prose

words.prose: {{ar:كُنتُمْ}} ({{tr:kuntum}}) carries the same second-person plural addressees into the relative clause and governs {{ar:تَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:ta'malūna}}) as a kāna-style auxiliary. The perfect plus imperfect makes the deeds habitual past practice, not an isolated act. The {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) range of being and occurrence is narrowed here to an established past state, so the deed record appears as what the addressees had been, not only what they once did. In the recurring accountability formula (6:93, 45:28), this auxiliary turns the factual event frame of 36:53 into the factual record of the addressees' own past.

topics.headline: habitual past subject continuity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people receiving recompense are grammatically the same people whose sustained past practice is being named.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a perfect 2mp auxiliary governing the following imperfect predicate.

topics.headline: being-root as fixed record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the being-root pressure makes the deeds feel like an established record, while local grammar keeps the selected function auxiliary and habitual.
topics.reason: The root range is broader than the auxiliary use, but the perfect auxiliary can still carry record-like being pressure without replacing the local construction.

topics.headline: formula and boundary handoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase belongs to a recurring accountability formula (6:93, 45:28) and converts the factual event frame of 36:53 into a factual deed record.
topics.reason: The formulaic parallels and boundary handoff are coherent with the local auxiliary construction and the preceding resurrection scene.

words.gloss_range: active second-person plural imperfect governed by the auxiliary, naming habitual accountable doing
words.root_gloss_range: work, action, performance, operation, productive output, and intentional deed; here intentional habitual doing is selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: cross-word grammatical anchor used in the local prose

words.prose: {{ar:تَعْمَلُونَ}} ({{tr:ta'malūna}}) closes the ayah with the active deed verb. Under {{ar:كُنتُمْ}} ({{tr:kuntum}}), its imperfect form names habitual past doing, and because it is active the addressees remain agents in the very clause where they receive recompense passively. The {{ar:ع م ل}} ({{tr:ʿ-m-l}}) field points to intentional work and performed output, so the final measure is not mere occurrence but accountable action. As the final word, it gives the judgment formula (7:147, 27:90) its landing on deeds, and it turns the worldly production language of 36:35 into the eschatological measure of recompense.

topics.headline: active habitual deed agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressees are passive recipients of recompense but active agents of the deeds that define it.
topics.reason: The verb is active 2mp imperfect, syntactically governed by the perfect auxiliary and sharing the same controlled subject.

topics.headline: intentional work as output
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deed basis is deliberate performed work, not accidental happening or a hidden intention detached from output.
topics.reason: The root range supports work, action, and production, while the local finite verb selects accountable doing in the relative clause.

topics.headline: final formulaic measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's final word leaves deeds as the legal and acoustic measure of the whole recompense rule.
topics.reason: Formulaic parallels (7:147, 27:90), same-surah echo (36:35), and final position all reinforce the local closing role of the active deed verb.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئًا ... وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive denial of wrong and the negation-exception around recompense form a fit constraint: an identifiable self receives no misplaced or withheld item, and its return is bounded by its own purposive work.

activation_trace.role: Putting something outside its proper time or place supplies the literal image of misplacement and makes non-wrong a rule against misassignment.
Withholding or confining a right supplies the complementary image and excludes an omitted due.
The very self or identity fixes the bearer to whom the account belongs.
Any knowable, reportable item gives the denial exhaustive object scope.
Answering an act with its consequence supplies the reciprocal accounting operation.
Purposive action supplies the attributable input to that operation.

changed_reading.before: A general assurance that judgment will be fair.
changed_reading.after: A precise non-misassignment rule: every identifiable self receives a fitting return for its own purposive acts, with neither foreign debit nor withheld due.

baseline_models.mechanism: The marked day, collection of a due, past occurrence, and the wage dimension of work combine into an account-closing event rather than a bare date label.

activation_trace.role: A day as a severe event or happening gives the deictic time the force of a decisive settlement.
Demanding and collecting a debt supplies the image of an account becoming due.
Occurrence and presence in past time fixes the work as an already accrued history.
A worker's wage or provision turns prior labor into a due return at closure.

changed_reading.before: Today merely locates a future verdict.
changed_reading.after: Today is the closing of an accrued account, when the history of work becomes a due return.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَفْسٌ ... وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The self as its own identity, together with the branch in which one thing stands in for another, makes the exception clause test whether recompense can be transferred, substituted, or discharged by a proxy.

activation_trace.role: Identity and very self supply the non-interchangeable account holder.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the possible proxy relation that the exception sharply restricts.
Withholding a right makes an unauthorized transfer a form of wrong rather than a neutral exchange.
Purposive action supplies the personal provenance that a proxy would have to displace.

changed_reading.before: Each person is judged, but mediation or transferred payment remains unspecified.
changed_reading.after: The account is provenance-bound: no substitute can replace the self's own purposive history as the basis of recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forgiveness that shields from an offense's effect, a generous wage, rescue solely by mercy, freely claimed or requested goods, and peace from a merciful lord prevent the exception from functioning as a simple ceiling on every positive gift. Deeds ground attribution and differentiation, while grace can exceed strict equivalence without wronging anyone.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal consequence supplies the baseline relation whose positive side is being tested for strict arithmetic.
Covering an offense and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies remission rather than bare equivalence.
The wage or return for work preserves a deed-linked basis for the promised good.
Honored generosity enlarges the wage image beyond minimal equivalence.
Tender mercy supplies the stated exception that preserves people when no rescue is available.
Claiming or calling for what is wanted supplies an open-ended beneficiary-side good.
Safety and freedom from harm supplies the culminating positive state.
Merciful tenderness identifies the source of that peace and keeps generosity inside the justice scene.

structural_cues: The early promise joins forgiveness to a generous wage, while the immediate post-focus sequence supplies desired goods and peace.
The exception to drowning in 36:44 is mercy, distinguishing gracious preservation from earned equivalence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deed-linked wage together with forgiveness, mercy, desired goods, and peace; I infer that the focus exception limits wrongful attribution more securely than it caps every benefit. A live alternative is that all listed goods are themselves exactly commensurate recompense.

changed_reading.before: Every outcome, good or bad, is numerically no more than the deed that earned it.
changed_reading.after: No adverse or differentiating outcome is falsely attributed, but the deed-grounded positive side may arrive through forgiveness and generous mercy rather than strict arithmetic alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior account writes what people sent ahead and their remaining traces, then enumerates every reportable thing. This expands the focus's work from momentary acts to attributable effects that persist beyond the act.

activation_trace.role: Purposive action remains the focus anchor whose temporal and causal extent is being expanded.
An inscription that establishes a binding judgment or determination supplies durable account registration.
Advancing something ahead supplies the direct acts sent before their agents.
A remaining mark that points back to what happened supplies propagated and enduring effects.
Every knowable, reportable item makes the record's scope coextensive with the focus's unrestricted object.
Counting by exhaustive enumeration supplies the mechanism that prevents an effect from being lost.

structural_cues: The coordinated objects of writing are what they advanced and their traces, followed by an all-things enumeration.
This recording statement precedes the focus and shares its unrestricted thing-expression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recorded direct advances, surviving traces, and exhaustive enumeration; I infer that recompensed work includes attributable aftereffects, not only the initiating gesture. A live alternative is that traces are recorded for another purpose and do not enlarge the recompense base.

changed_reading.before: What you did means only each completed, immediate act.
changed_reading.after: What you did includes the purposive act together with the attributable traces it set in motion and that the account preserves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Potential substitute routes are tested across the surah and fail: an intercessor cannot join itself to the threatened person effectively, no one extracts that person from danger, no answering rescuer responds, and adopted helpers become an assembled host rather than providers of aid. The focus's provenance-bound account is therefore operational, not merely grammatical.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing in another's place supplies the focus-side possibility of substitution.
A helper joining itself to another supplies the attempted intercessory route.
Extracting someone from a predicament or another's hand supplies the rescue that the attempted route cannot perform.
Answering a cry with aid supplies a second rescue channel that is explicitly absent.
Extraction from danger repeats as the unavailable result, making the failure structural.
Aid that makes its recipient prevail supplies the expected function of the adopted powers.
A mutually supporting host supplies the ironic collective form of those unable to help.
Presence and being brought near converts would-be helpers into fellow assembled subjects.

structural_cues: The same no-benefit and no-rescue pattern appears in 36:23, 36:43, and 36:74-75.
Would-be helpers end in the same brought-present posture used for the universal assembly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed intercession, rescue, and aid followed by shared presence; I infer that no external agent can take over the self's account. A live alternative is that these failures concern worldly protection only, while the focus itself leaves other mediation unaddressed.

changed_reading.before: The focus assigns deeds personally but leaves practical substitute routes open.
changed_reading.after: The surah repeatedly closes substitute routes: helpers cannot replace, extract, or discharge the self whose own work supplies the account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's what-you-worked formula is bracketed by fruit and what human hands worked, then by creatures made through divine hands and placed under human ownership. Work remains genuinely embodied and attributable, but it occurs inside received creation and provision, so its accountable quality includes how gifts are handled and acknowledged.

activation_trace.role: Purposive action anchors the repeated work formula whose agency relation changes.
The fruit as realized benefit supplies the material field in which human work appears.
Purposive work repeats in a construction closely matching the focus and links accountability to productive handling.
What hands earn supplies embodied provenance for the human side of work.
Recognizing a benefit and praising its giver assigns grateful response as the expected orientation of work.
Bringing creation into being supplies the prior productive agency within which human action operates.
The same purposive-work branch is assigned to divine hands, preventing work from being treated as an exclusively human possession.
The hand as bestowed benefit turns the created material into an entrusted gift.
Livestock as material wealth supplies the concrete object placed within human use.
Possession and power of disposal supplies the delegated control in which responsible action occurs.

structural_cues: The close verbal pattern around work and hands occurs at 36:35, 36:54, and 36:71.
Both provision passages end by testing human response: gratitude in 36:35 and again after the benefits listed in 36:73.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated work-hand constructions, created provision, possession, and gratitude; I infer nested agency in which human deeds are responsible uses of received materials. The live syntactic alternative in 36:35 is that human hands did not make the fruit, which would intensify rather than remove the dependence claim.

changed_reading.before: What you worked denotes self-originating deed units detached from their material conditions.
changed_reading.after: What you worked is embodied and truly yours, yet judged as a use or response within provision and productive powers you did not originate.

context_deltas.mechanism: A command to let allotted provision go outward is answered by refusing to feed and by relocating responsibility to divine will; later benefits again call for gratitude. Against the focus's withholding branch of wrong, what people worked includes purposive non-action that blocks a provision's social passage.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and confining a right anchors the focus in distributive harm.
Purposive action supplies the category into which a deliberate refusal may be read.
Money going out in expenditure supplies the requested outward movement of provision.
An apportioned gift supplies what is held and could be passed onward.
Covering over a benefit supplies the refusal's ingratitude and concealment mechanism.
Feeding another and requesting food supplies the concrete social act refused and reassigned.
Acknowledging benefit and its giver supplies the opposite response to concealed or hoarded provision.

structural_cues: The speakers answer an imperative to spend with a rhetorical refusal to feed, shifting the act to what God could have done.
The provision-benefit sequence later repeats the question of gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outgoing expenditure, allotted provision, refused feeding, covered benefit, and gratitude; I infer that a deliberate omission can belong to purposive work when it withholds a social due. A live alternative limits work to overt acts and treats the refusal only as accompanying speech.

changed_reading.before: Only overt deeds are returned, and no-wrong concerns the court's procedure.
changed_reading.after: The account can include deliberate withholding: justice answers not only what hands did, but the social good they purposively prevented from passing onward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge asks when the promise will occur; after awakening, the speakers identify the event as the Merciful's promise and the messengers' truth. The focus's today is therefore the arrival of a previously marked appointment, and its no-wrong clause is also promise-keeping.

activation_trace.role: A bounded span or occasion supplies the deictic time whose identity the context resolves.
A promise fixed to a time or place supplies the questioned appointment.
A spoken promise that opens expectation supplies the now-recognized event.
Tender mercy identifies the promisor and prevents the appointment from being framed as sheer hostility.
Making a promise true in action supplies fulfillment rather than mere verbal correctness.
Messengers and message supply the prior communication now verified by arrival.

structural_cues: The when-question in 36:48 is answered by recognition in 36:52 and the deictic today in 36:54.
Promise and messenger-truth occur inside the same awakening-to-assembly sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a questioned appointment, its recognition as promised, and enacted truth immediately before today; I infer that 36:54 is the promise's performative arrival. A live alternative treats today as generic courtroom deixis without answering the earlier when.

changed_reading.before: Today is an isolated courtroom timestamp.
changed_reading.after: Today is the long-questioned appointment becoming present, so exact recompense also enacts the truth of the prior promise.

context_deltas.mechanism: One arresting cry interrupts live disputation, removes the chance to transmit a final instruction or return home, then the raised people rush out and are gathered into immediate presence. The focus stands exactly at the switch from alterable action to closed history: what you were doing is no longer editable and is now present for return.

activation_trace.role: Past occurrence fixes work as a completed temporal history once the switch has happened.
A terrifying cry supplies the abrupt transition signal.
Being seized on account of fault supplies the closure of ongoing disputation.
An instruction connected and handed on to another supplies the last action that can no longer be performed.
Returning to a former place supplies the unavailable route back into ordinary agency.
Rapid propulsion supplies the movement from graves toward the new scene.
Rousing what was still supplies the reactivation that does not reopen the prior work period.
Joining dispersed persons into one gathered whole supplies universal convergence.
Immediate presence and proximity supplies the completed delivery into accounting.

structural_cues: The ordered sequence is live dispute, sudden seizure, inability to make a final disposition or return, rapid emergence, and universal presence.
The focus opens with a consequential fa and today immediately after everyone is brought present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interruption, blocked final acts, irreversible departure, emergence, gathering, and presence; I infer a one-way phase change from mutable work to immutable record. A live alternative is that the sequence marks speed only and says nothing about closure of moral agency.

changed_reading.before: Past tense merely reports that deeds happened earlier.
changed_reading.after: The past wording marks a sealed action phase: one interruption turns ongoing life into a fixed history delivered immediately for recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, one group is constituted by companionship, a sheltered garden, absorbing occupation, and delight; then the other is commanded to separate as perpetrators. Recompense therefore materializes as social and spatial sorting into distinct modes of life, not only as quantities handed to isolated persons.

activation_trace.role: The individual self anchors the unit that is then placed into a differentiated collective condition.
Companionship and sustained association supply the positive group's relational form.
A garden sheltered by growth supplies that group's spatial environment.
Occupation as the opposite of vacancy supplies an absorbing mode of existence rather than a static prize.
Delight and agreeable well-being supplies the affective quality of that occupation.
Sorting until one thing is visibly distinct from another supplies the judgment's spatial operation.
Offense and culpable act supplies the basis naming the separated group.

structural_cues: The positive collective scene begins in the verse immediately after the focus; the command to separate follows four verses later and repeats today.
The text moves from universal selves to visibly differentiated communities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasting group labels, environments, occupations, affects, and an explicit sorting command; I infer that recompense is enacted as placement into fitting social worlds. A live alternative treats these as later consequences without making sorting part of the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an item transferred to each isolated individual.
changed_reading.after: Recompense also sorts selves into fitting relational, spatial, and affective worlds generated by their differing histories.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaking mouth is sealed while hands address the judge and feet testify about acquisition. The same body that performed and accumulated the work becomes its evidentiary surface, explaining how the focus's passive non-wrong avoids false self-report and mistaken attribution.

activation_trace.role: The self as the person's very identity supplies the whole whose organs become evidence.
Purposive action supplies what must be attributed without distortion.
A secured, preventing seal disables the ordinary channel of self-presentation.
The mouth as an opening supplies the channel that is closed.
Meaningful speech connecting interlocutors transfers testimony to the hands.
The hand as bodily organ supplies an executor of deeds that can now report them.
Making a statement from knowledge supplies the evidentiary function of the feet.
The foot or leg supplies the body's traveled and enacted record.
Acquisitive bodily instruments supply a bridge between what was gained and the organs that gained it.

structural_cues: The verse repeats today and a what-they-used-to construction, closely echoing the focus.
Agency and evidence are redistributed in sequence: mouth disabled, hands speaking, feet witnessing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sealed speech, speaking hands, witnessing feet, and acquired acts; I infer that bodily participation serves as self-authenticating evidence for exact attribution. A live alternative is that the scene only dramatizes omniscience and does not explain the focus's non-wrong mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Fairness is asserted without showing how contested deeds are assigned.
changed_reading.after: Fairness is evidentiary and embodied: the acting self carries a distributed record that can testify when strategic speech is disabled.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ج ز ز target bundled with focus ج ز ي and crosses into the surah's cultivation sequence. It remains anchored in the focus verb's supplied split inventory and in today as the moment of settlement, while seed, emergence, and fruit make maturation-to-cutting coherent. Downstream prose should call it a harvest-like activation, not claim that تُجْزَوْنَ lexically means cutting.

activation_trace.role: A decisive day-event supplies the harvest-like moment of conversion.
The alternate mapped root's time of cutting when growth is ripe supplies the deliberately form-distant harvest image.
Purposive action supplies what has developed toward the harvest-like outcome.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies manifestation of a previously hidden product.
A seed that grows and bears supplies the latent beginning of the result.
Ripe fruit supplies the matured endpoint ready to be gathered.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is an externally assigned payment after action.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, today is harvest: purposive work has grown into a manifest, ripe consequence that is now cut or gathered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it maps celestial motion onto adjudication. It remains anchored in the focus branch of putting nothing outside its proper place and is supported by measured courses in which one body does not overtake another. Downstream prose should present calibrated trajectories as a structural analogy for justice, not identify cosmic mechanics with the legal meaning.

activation_trace.role: Putting something outside its proper place supplies the focus-side prohibition on displacement.
A regular course or established way supplies stable trajectory.
Ordering by measure and considered determination supplies calibration.
A measure by which a thing reaches its bound supplies assigned stages.
Escaping or getting beyond a pursuer supplies the overtaking that the ordered scene denies.
A celestial course supplies the bounded track within which each motion remains.

changed_reading.before: No wrong means only that a judge avoids an unfair decision.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, no wrong is calibrated non-encroachment: each self and deed reaches its own measured course without another outcome overtaking or displacing it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it recasts recompense from a payment into a trajectory. It remains anchored in the focus's purposive work and reciprocal consequence, while the context repeatedly joins a straight path to movement, failed sight, inability to proceed, and inability to return. Downstream prose should describe consequence as path-like realization, not replace the ordinary recompense sense.

activation_trace.role: An act answered by its consequence anchors the path as realized return rather than an unrelated theme.
A worked, well-traveled road supplies an internal action-to-path bridge.
The straight road supplies the explicitly prescribed trajectory.
Straightness, balance, and evenness supply the road's norm.
Loss of sight supplies an inability to navigate the trajectory.
Racing ahead supplies attempted motion on the path.
The road repeats as the site where prior orientation becomes consequential.
Passing onward supplies the forward movement that can become unavailable.
Returning to what was supplies the reverse movement that is also closed.

changed_reading.before: Consequences are detached awards imposed after the road of action ends.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, recompense is the road becoming final: repeated orientations harden into the trajectory one can or cannot traverse.

strongest_changes: The account's object expands from isolated acts to direct advances plus their recorded, attributable traces.
The one-cry sequence turns today into a phase boundary where alterable action becomes closed history in immediate presence.
Speaking hands and witnessing feet make exact non-misassignment an embodied evidentiary mechanism.
The immediate garden and separation sequence realizes recompense as social and spatial sorting.
Forgiveness, mercy, generous wage, desired goods, and peace keep deed-based justice from collapsing into a purely positive arithmetic ceiling.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus operate as a hinge among repeated work-and-hand constructions, comprehensive recording, abrupt assembly, outcome sorting, and bodily testimony. Its split ج ز ي inventory also preserved a contained harvest activation, while measured celestial courses and traversed paths supplied two cross-domain models of non-displacement.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether recorded traces enlarge the recompense base or are only a parallel record remains inferential.
The exception may impose strict equivalence on all outcomes, only exclude alien attribution, or operate differently on adverse return and gracious benefit.
The syntactic force of the work-and-hands phrase in 36:35 remains live, although either major reading supports nested human agency.
The harvest, calibrated-course, and realized-path models are structurally anchored but should remain explicitly metaphorical and exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Recompense is constrained to enacted work.** `ي و م` B003 is a severe event-day; `ن ف س` B011 the living self; `ش ي ء` B001 a knowable thing; `ج ز ي` B001 matching recompense; `ع م ل` B001 intentional work. The double negation excludes both wrong and payment beyond action. I infer that exact matching is the mechanism by which non-wronging is secured. The ayah reads as bounded adjudication.
2. **No self is put in the wrong place.** `ظ ل م` B004 is doing something at the wrong concrete time or place. Universal presentation has put all before the judging presence; recompense now places consequences against their proper deeds. I infer that justice is spatial-temporal fit, not only absence of cruelty. The ayah activates an ordering sense of non-injustice.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:65 immediately supplied the material basis of matching: work has left testimony in the working body. This made non-wronging a relation between deed, trace, and consequence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Recompense reattaches each whole self to its own work.** **ي و م B003** anchors a major event-day; **ن ف س B012** supplies whole identity; **ش ي ء B001** a knowable thing; **ج ز ي B001** recompense matching an act; and **ع م ل B001** intentional doing. Universal gathering precedes in 36:53, but the fixed singular **نَفْسٌ** and restrictive **إِلَّا مَا** re-individualize the assembly. The packet supplies gathering and exact matching; the inferred arrow is *presence does not pool liability: judgment maps each action back to the self that intentionally produced it*. Non-wrong is structural non-substitution.
2. **Hidden inwardness cannot escape the matching operation.** **ن ف س B013** supplies inner thought or intent, while **ج ز ي B001** supplies reciprocal return. Garden delight and criminal separation follow (36:55–59). The packet does not state the full causal metric; the abductive move is *because recompense is restricted to what “you were doing,” outward and inward agency must be carried into the match*. This exploratory reading makes the no-grievance claim in **ظ ل م B003** a statement of complete attribution.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** The sorting command of 36:59 makes the matching operation spatially visible: exact recompense does not leave unlike work pooled in one assembly but separates populations according to what they incurred.

baseline.text: O gün hiç kimseye hiçbir haksızlık yapılmaz ve yalnızca yaptıklarınızın karşılığını alırsınız.

findings.text: Toplu huzurda bile sorumluluk havuzlanmaz; her bütün kişi kendi bilinçli işiyle yeniden eşleştirilir.
Haksızlık yapılmaması, her kişiyi ve eylemi doğru sonuç konumuna yerleştiren bir uygunluk düzeni olarak belirir.
Karşılığın yalnız yapılanla sınırlanması, görünür eylemin ardındaki iç yönelişin de eksiksiz eşleştirmeye taşındığını düşündürür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conduct remains attached to the actor and can be converted into exact compensation and bodily testimony.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: A word can also be a wound, so the body's speaking limbs resemble inscribed marks left by action.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Exact settlement of action
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A decisive event-day fixes each self to its act and settles the account without moving a right from its proper holder.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: severe event-day (quranic:root_001700:B003/m01); wrongful displacement (quranic:root_000967:B004/m01); withholding a right (quranic:root_000967:B008/m01); self as the thing itself (quranic:root_001533:B012/m01); reciprocal compensation (quranic:root_000244:B001/m01); one thing standing for another (quranic:root_000244:B002/m01); debt settlement (quranic:root_000244:B003/m01); intentional act (quranic:root_001046:B001/m01); acquired earning (quranic:root_001296:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Justice is modeled as correct placement and settlement. No right is shifted out of position; act, actor, and compensating return remain aligned as in an account whose debt is exactly discharged.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bilinen günü güneşin doğuşundan batışına kadar süren zaman olarak tanımlar ve onu günler dizisinin tek bir birimi sayar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu iki kurucu özelliği de doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca sınırları gün doğumu ve gün batımıyla belirlenen gündüz süresini kapsar; belirsiz süre, devir ve olay anlamları ayrı dallardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanımı tanımlar; günlük işlem bildiren türemiş kullanım, temel gün anlamının yerine geçirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Güneşin doğuşundan batışına kadar uzanan bilinen zaman aralığı ve bu aralıklardan oluşan dizinin tek bir birimidir.

facets.statement: Başlangıcı güneşin doğuşu, sonu güneşin batışıdır; aynı zamanda sayılabilen günlerden biridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bilinen günün güneşin doğuşuyla başlayıp batışıyla bittiği ve çoğulu bulunan sayılabilir bir zaman birimi olduğu konusunda birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Günün geceyi dışarıda bırakan, doğal ışık sınırlarıyla belirlenmiş tek bir zaman birimi olarak kastedildiği kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem gün doğumu ile gün batımı arasındaki sınırı hem de tek bir gün birimi olmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Karşıtlığın geceyle kurulduğu ve sayılabilir birim özelliğinin bağlamdan zaten anlaşıldığı cümlelerde doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Güneşin doğuşu ile batışı arasındaki aydınlık zaman aralığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hem doğal gündüz sınırının hem de bunun tek bir sayılabilir birim olduğunun açıkça belirtilmesi gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sınırlandırılmış gündüz süresini ve onun tek bir gün birimi oluşunu birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gün gün veya gündelik esasa göre yapılan işlem

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gün doğumunu kesin başlangıç sayar ve aralığı sayılabilir tek bir gün birimi olarak kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gündüz ışığını ve şafaktan gün batımına uzanan süreyi kapsar; ayrıca gündüzle ilişkili başka kullanımları da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de gecenin karşısındaki aydınlık zaman kesitini gün batımına kadar anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, başlangıcı güneşin doğuşu olan sayılabilir günü tanımlar. Komşu dal ise şafaktan başlayan gündüzü ve onun ışığını öne çıkarır; bu yüzden sınırları tam örtüşmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Süreyi gün doğumu ile gün batımı arasında kesin olarak sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Her uzunluktaki bir zaman dilimini ve bazı bağlamlarda bir devri anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir zaman kesitini gün sözü üzerinden kavramlaştırır.

facets.statement: Isigin gitmesi, yok olmasi veya gorunurun kapanmasi kolun cekirdegidir.
Bilgisizlik, ortak kosma ve yoldan cikma gibi soyut durumlar karanliga benzetilerek anlatilir.
Bir kisinin, toplulugun, yerin veya gecenin karanliga girmesi bu cekirdege bagli bir kullanimdir.
Ay icindeki belirli karanlik geceler ve gorusu ilk kapatan an, cekirdegin zamanla ilgili ornekleridir.
